title: Celestial Sorceress
description: A female character with long flowing blue hair and elf-like ears stands dynamically in the center, wearing a form-fitting white and blue armored outfit with a short skirt and thigh-high boots. She holds a large glowing blue magical staff in her right hand while her left hand is raised, surrounded by floating pink petals, ethereal energy swirls, and fantastical flora against a luminous sky.
